reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount helper, routes the API and existing calculation sites through it, and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: Removes repeated amount dispatch and midpoint calculations without introducing duplicate rule implementations.

placement.why: Schedule amount policy remains in shared/schedules, tolerance stays in shared/rules, and API projection stays in api-models.

scope.why: Changes are focused on expected schedule amounts, their consumers, API types, tests, and release documentation.

maintainability.why: Centralized policy simplifies maintenance, although the optional string operator after a positional boolean makes the helper contract less explicit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Changed consumers consistently delegate expected-amount calculation to getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: Existing inline calculations are replaced with shared helper calls rather than reshaped copies.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount adds the optional op parameter and an isapprox branch that delegates tolerance calculation to getApproxNumberThreshold.
